description: Tells the TikiAPI team about a problem: an order stuck for much longer than its eta_seconds, a charge that looks wrong, a broken result. Give the ids it concerns (orders, edits, speech or transcription calls) and a short description. Use it once per problem, after checking get_generation: a failed order is never charged.

ids.description: The ids it concerns: orders, edits, speech or transcription calls.

text.description: What happened, in a few sentences: what was expected and what came back.

name: report_problem
title: Report a problem
